_README: Label id -> structure name for the Visible Human FEMALE trunk-wall sheet volume (scripts/trunk_wall_from_ct.py: diaphragm and intercostal sheets by geometric rules on the `total` labels), plus the mapping onto atlas entities.

A KEY, not data. Rule-based: textbook sheets placed by distance rules, not segmentations; badge it. The intercostal sheet stands for all three layers (external, internal, innermost) which CT cannot separate.
source: U.S. National Library of Medicine, The Visible Human Project (public domain), female fresh-cadaver 'Normal' CT via the NCI Imaging Data Commons; TotalSegmentator v2.18.0 `total` labels.

diaphragm.note: 4 mm sheet between the lung/heart and liver/spleen/stomach labels, costal part to the costal margin, crura on T12-L3; rule-based.

intercostals_right.note: ONE sheet for the external, internal and innermost intercostals of the right side (not separable on CT); rule-based.

intercostals_left.note: ONE sheet for the external, internal and innermost intercostals of the left side (not separable on CT); rule-based.
